options.content: **Failure detection**: 50 simulated machines; one crashes every 45 s and one stalls (stays connected but goes silent) every 30 s. Crashes are caught through MQTT's Last Will, stalls by a phi accrual detector on each machine's heartbeats. [Code](https://github.com/kabilaymen/vigil) · other dashboards: Gateway, Fleet history (Dashboards menu)

panels.title: Machines down
panels.description: Machines currently suspected (silent) or disconnected. The simulator crashes one every 45 s and stalls one every 30 s.

panels.title: Detector lag
panels.description: How far behind the stream the detector is. Above 2 s it stops judging machines: the silence would be its own.

panels.title: Alerts / min
panels.description: suspected = silent but still connected (phi accrual); connection_lost = the broker published the machine's Last Will.

panels.title: Stalled machines: time to detection (last hour)
panels.description: Silence since the machine's last message when the phi accrual detector declared it, counted per interval.

panels.title: Crashed machines: time to detection (last hour)
panels.description: Silence since the machine's last message when its Last Will arrived, counted per interval.

panels.title: φ of the 5 most suspicious machines (alert at 8)
panels.description: Suspicion level, recomputed every 200 ms from each machine's own heartbeat rhythm. A stalled machine climbs past 8 in about a second.
